## Reproduce it

```
go run ./tools/gauntlet run reference-ec2-vpc
```

Needs Docker (the emulator is pulled at the pinned digest), the AWS CLI, and a
stock `terraform` or `tofu` binary on PATH for the cold deploy. The script is
`live/e2e/reference-ec2-vpc/run.sh`; `BREAK=1` corrupts its assertions to show they are load-bearing.
